fieldValues.title: The muDemocracy site publishes essays from their records
fieldValues.move: The site, not the editor, publishes: muSrs is where the first essays live, and the site's build (publish-musrs.mjs, which already renders problems and routines from muSrs records) renders each essay marked for publishing into a page. The records stay the single source and the page is a projection; the editor only writes the records and needs no publishing feature of its own. Lower priority than writing the essays themselves (owner, 2026-10-16).
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Distribution beyond the site, scheduling, and publishing essays that live in repositories other than muSrs.
fieldValues.falsifier: A published essay on the site differs from its record after the next build, or publishing an essay needs a step outside marking it and the normal site build.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-16: publish essays from where they are written
fieldValues.return_when: When the first essay has gone from the editor to the site this way and the owner has said whether publishing felt like one act.
